summary: All five phases complete and committed. The Core->Bundle directory import cycle is gone (29 pure-syntax declarations relocated to Syntax/SubformulaClosure/IteratedTemporal.lean, so Core/RestrictedMCS/Basic.lean no longer imports Bundle/), the seven live ModalSaturation helpers migrated to Theorems/ModalDerived.lean and Core/MCSProperties.lean, and the resulting six-module dead half of Bundle/ is archived at Boneyard/BundleDeadHalf/ with a README. Metalogic/ now has exactly one directory-level import cycle, asserted mechanically by the new scripts/check-metalogic-cycles.sh. Every phase boundary was lake build green and check-module-invariants.sh ALL CHECKS PASSED with no carve-out, and the C2 flagship axiom baseline is byte-identical throughout.

decisions_made: Metalogic/README.md's Cycle 2 section and docs/architecture/BFMCS_ARCHITECTURE.md's three slash paths were fixed in Phase 4, not Phase 5: both are gate-load-bearing (C5 and C12 respectively) and deferring either would have left the Phase 4 boundary red, which the plan forbids.

The two unqualified SetMaximalConsistent.contrapositive sites needed no added open -- both files already carry open FormalSystem.Metalogic.Core -- so the plan's open-insertion task was skipped rather than performed pointlessly. Chronicle/MCSMixedCase.lean needed no edit at all for the same reason.

Every cross-file reference to the migrated derivation-tree helpers was fully qualified as FormalSystem.Theorems.ModalDerived.<name> rather than resolved by an added open; only the two files with internal unqualified uses of dneTheorem got the open.

scripts/check-metalogic-cycles.sh is catalogued in docs/development/MODULE_INVARIANTS.md, not in .claude/docs/reference/utility-scripts-inventory.md: that path is gitignored here (.gitignore:85) and its agent-system/extensions/** source store is absent, so an entry there would be discarded by the next deploy.
divergences_from_plan: Fully-qualified references: 10 across 6 modules, not the report's 7 or 9. Phase 1's enumeration was authoritative, as the plan intended; all 10 rewritten.
WitnessSeed.lean has four temp_a mentions (:561, :565, :566, :572), not three.
The 23 external archived import lines sit in 18 archived files, not 14; the plan's own enumeration lists 23 entries over 18 distinct paths.

C11's archived import-line total is NOT unchanged: 497 -> 527, because the six moved files bring their own 30 import lines into the archived population. The plan's reasoning here was wrong; all 527 resolve and the waived count is unchanged at 7.

untl/snce: a unit correction, not a value correction. SuccRelation.lean has 12 occurrences on 10 lines, and CanonicalTaskRelation.lean's 2 moved to the live IteratedTemporal.lean in Phase 2. What travels to the archive is 14 occurrences / 12 lines / 2 files, so the plan's total of 14 stands.

Metalogic/README.md carried three further stale rows unrelated to this task (Independence/ 3 -> 6 files, SoundnessLemmas/ 5 -> 3, top-line 314 -> 315); corrected under Phase 5's reconcile-every-count instruction.
